title: Source coverage and source-family behavior pack
notes: This pack widens source-family coverage beyond the original fleet, scanner, OpenClaw, Windows and Linux packs.
It is tuned for application, identity, and telemetry continuity signals across Nextcloud, Gitea, Navidrome, VPN edge and generic fleet telemetry.
Suppression key: host.name + service.name + source family.

stream_rules.title: Nextcloud Authentication Failure Burst
stream_rules.operator_action: Check whether the burst is user-caused, SSO drift, or credential abuse against the collaboration surface.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Nextcloud Authentication Failure Burst
id: sigma-nextcloud-auth-failure-burst
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: linux
  service: nextcloud
detection:
  selection_host:
    host.name: nextcloud-siem
  selection_auth:
    message|contains:
      - login failed
      - authentication failed
      - invalid password
  condition: selection_host and selection_auth
level: medium
tags:
  - nextcloud
  - auth

stream_rules.title: Gitea Administrative Change Burst
stream_rules.operator_action: Review whether repository, org, or admin-scope changes were expected and tied to the intended operator identity.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Gitea Administrative Change Burst
id: sigma-gitea-administrative-change-burst
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: linux
  service: gitea
detection:
  selection_host:
    host.name: pilot-web-01
  selection_message:
    message|contains:
      - admin
      - repository deleted
      - organization deleted
      - user promoted
  condition: selection_host and selection_message
level: high
tags:
  - gitea
  - admin

stream_rules.title: Navidrome Proxy Authentication Failure Burst

title: Navidrome Proxy Authentication Failure Burst
id: sigma-navidrome-proxy-auth-failure-burst

stream_rules.title: VPN Edge Telemetry Drop
stream_rules.operator_action: Treat missing VPN edge telemetry as both an observability and security gap. Check OpenClaw and external VPN nodes immediately.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: VPN Edge Telemetry Drop
id: sigma-vpn-edge-telemetry-drop
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: custom
  service: host-runtime
detection:
  selection_source:
    source.family:
      - openclaw
      - vpn.xray
  selection_state:
    event.type:
      - host_runtime_stale
      - source_stale
      - source_missing
  condition: selection_source and selection_state
level: high
tags:
  - vpn
  - telemetry

stream_rules.title: Proxmox Fleet and Scan Drift
stream_rules.operator_action: Check whether new or renamed guests lost monitoring or scanner coverage after Proxmox inventory drift.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Proxmox Fleet and Scan Drift
id: sigma-proxmox-fleet-and-scan-drift
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: custom
  service: proxmox-fleet
detection:
  selection:
    event.type:
      - proxmox_inventory_drift
      - proxmox_guest_unmapped
      - scanner_target_drift
  condition: selection
level: medium
tags:
  - proxmox
  - inventory
  - scanner

stream_rules.title: PostgreSQL Authentication Failure Burst
stream_rules.operator_action: Check whether the failures are caused by a broken application secret, brute-force activity, or a service-account drift on the database node.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: PostgreSQL Authentication Failure Burst
id: sigma-postgresql-auth-failure-burst
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: linux
  service: postgresql
detection:
  selection_host:
    host.name: pilot-db-01
  selection_message:
    message|contains:
      - password authentication failed
      - authentication failed
      - no pg_hba.conf entry
  condition: selection_host and selection_message
level: high
tags:
  - postgres
  - auth

stream_rules.title: Valkey Persistence Or Restart Burst
stream_rules.operator_action: Review whether Valkey restarts, AOF/RDB persistence failures, or memory-pressure events are breaking cache-backed workflows.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Valkey Persistence Or Restart Burst
id: sigma-valkey-persistence-or-restart-burst
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: linux
  service: valkey
detection:
  selection_host:
    host.name: pilot-cache-01
  selection_message:
    message|contains:
      - Background saving terminated by signal
      - Ready to accept connections
      - Failed opening the temp RDB file
      - Out Of Memory
  condition: selection_host and selection_message
level: medium
tags:
  - valkey
  - cache

stream_rules.title: SIEM Web Or Keycloak Authentication Degradation
stream_rules.operator_action: Treat repeated SIEM or Keycloak login failures as a platform access issue. Verify IdP reachability, session cookies, and break-glass availability.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: SIEM Web Or Keycloak Authentication Degradation
id: sigma-siem-web-or-keycloak-auth-degradation
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: linux
  service: siem-web
detection:
  selection_host:
    host.name: siem-vm4
  selection_message:
    message|contains:
      - login failed
      - oidc
      - keycloak
      - csrf
      - access denied
  condition: selection_host and selection_message
level: high
tags:
  - siem
  - keycloak
  - auth

stream_rules.title: Generic Source Telemetry Stall
stream_rules.operator_action: Inspect the stalled source or collector before data loss propagates into incidents, AI assessments, or scanner coverage gaps.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Generic Source Telemetry Stall
id: sigma-generic-source-telemetry-stall
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: custom
  service: source-health
detection:
  selection_state:
    event.type:
      - source_stale
      - source_missing
      - collector_stale
      - collector_missing
  condition: selection_state
level: medium
tags:
  - telemetry
  - source

stream_rules.sigma_yaml:

level: medium
tags:
  - windows
  - bsd
  - coverage

  - ssh
